name: cf-blog
description: A Cloudflare-native personal blog with an Astro frontend, React CMS, D1, R2, and MCP support.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cf-blog/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/markdown typecheck && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/cms build && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/blog build
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n cms,admin,blog -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @cf-blog/cms dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @cf-blog/cms dev:client" "pnpm --filter @cf-blog/blog dev"
scripts.deploy: pnpm check && pnpm db:migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/cms deploy && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/blog deploy
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cf-blog/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/markdown typecheck && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/cms typecheck && pnpm --filter @cf-blog/blog typecheck
